Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.tr: Çok fazla hatalı kod var. Kodla oturum açma 15 dakika süreyle duraklatılır. Daha sonra deneyin veya bilgisayarı kontrol edin.
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.vi: Quá nhiều mã sai. Đăng nhập bằng mã bị tạm dừng trong 15 phút. Hãy thử lại sau hoặc kiểm tra máy tính.
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.th: รหัสไม่ถูกต้องมากเกินไป การลงชื่อเข้าใช้รหัสจะถูกหยุดชั่วคราวเป็นเวลา 15 นาที ลองใหม่ภายหลังหรือตรวจสอบคอมพิวเตอร์
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.nl: Te veel onjuiste codes. Het inloggen met de code wordt 15 minuten onderbroken. Probeer het later of controleer de computer.
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.pl: Za dużo błędnych kodów. Logowanie za pomocą kodu zostało wstrzymane na 15 minut. Spróbuj później lub sprawdź komputer.
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.uk: Забагато неправильних кодів. Вхід за кодом призупинено на 15 хвилин. Спробуйте пізніше або перевірте комп’ютер.
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.hi: बहुत सारे ग़लत कोड. कोड साइन-इन 15 मिनट के लिए रोक दिया गया है। बाद में प्रयास करें या कंप्यूटर की जाँच करें।
Too many incorrect codes. Code sign-in i.ms: Terlalu banyak kod yang salah. Log masuk kod dijeda selama 15 minit. Cuba kemudian atau semak komputer.

This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.en: This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pairing expired, or the computer removed it. Enter an access code.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.zh-Hans: 此浏览器未配对，或配对已满 7 天、已被电脑取消。请输入动态码。
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.fr: Ce navigateur n’est plus associé, son association de 7 jours a expiré ou a été supprimée. Saisissez un code d’accès.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.de: Browser nicht gekoppelt, 7-Tage-Kopplung abgelaufen oder entfernt. Zugangscode eingeben.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.ar: المتصفح غير مقترن، أو انتهت مدة الاقتران البالغة 7 أيام، أو أزال الحاسوب الاقتران. أدخل رمز الدخول.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.zh-Hant: 此瀏覽器未配對，或配對已滿 7 天、已被電腦取消。請輸入動態碼。
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.ja: このブラウザはペアリングが解除されているか、7 日間のペアリングの期限が切れているか、コンピュータによってペアリングが削除されています。アクセスコードを入力します。
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.ko: 이 브라우저는 페어링되지 않았거나 7일 페어링이 만료되었거나 컴퓨터에서 브라우저를 제거했습니다. 액세스 코드를 입력하세요.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.pt: Este navegador não está emparelhado, o emparelhamento de 7 dias expirou ou o computador o removeu. Insira um código de acesso.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.es: Este navegador no está emparejado, su emparejamiento de 7 días expiró o la computadora lo eliminó. Introduzca un código de acceso.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.it: Questo browser non è abbinato, il suo abbinamento di 7 giorni è scaduto o il computer lo ha rimosso. Inserisci un codice di accesso.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.ru: Этот браузер не подключен, срок его 7-дневного сопряжения истек или компьютер удалил его. Введите код доступа.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.id: Browser ini tidak dipasangkan, pemasangan 7 hari telah habis masa berlakunya, atau komputer menghapusnya. Masukkan kode akses.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.tr: Bu tarayıcının eşleşmesi kaldırılmış, 7 günlük eşleştirme süresi dolmuş veya bilgisayar tarayıcıyı kaldırmış. Bir erişim kodu girin.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.vi: Trình duyệt này chưa được ghép nối, quá trình ghép nối 7 ngày của nó đã hết hạn hoặc máy tính đã xóa nó. Nhập mã truy cập.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.th: เบราว์เซอร์นี้ไม่ได้จับคู่ การจับคู่ 7 วันหมดอายุ หรือคอมพิวเตอร์ลบออก ป้อนรหัสการเข้าถึง
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.nl: Deze browser is ontkoppeld, de koppelingsperiode van zeven dagen is verstreken of de computer heeft deze verwijderd. Voer een toegangscode in.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.pl: Ta przeglądarka nie jest sparowana, jej 7-dniowe parowanie wygasło lub komputer ją usunął. Wprowadź kod dostępu.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.uk: Цей веб-переглядач не підключено, термін його 7-денного підключення минув або комп’ютер видалив його. Введіть код доступу.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.hi: यह ब्राउज़र अयुग्मित है, इसकी 7-दिवसीय युग्मन समाप्त हो गई है, या कंप्यूटर ने इसे हटा दिया है। एक एक्सेस कोड दर्ज करें.
This browser is unpaired, its 7-day pair.ms: Penyemak imbas ini dinyahgandingkan, gandingan 7 harinya tamat tempoh atau komputer mengalih keluarnya. Masukkan kod akses.

The computer could not save pairing chan.en: The computer could not save pairing changes. Try again later.
The computer could not save pairing chan.zh-Hans: 电脑暂时无法保存配对变更，请稍后重试。
The computer could not save pairing chan.fr: L’ordinateur n’a pas pu enregistrer l’association. Réessayez plus tard.
The computer could not save pairing chan.de: Kopplungsänderungen konnten nicht gespeichert werden. Später erneut versuchen.
The computer could not save pairing chan.ar: تعذّر حفظ تغييرات الاقتران على الحاسوب. حاول لاحقًا.
The computer could not save pairing chan.zh-Hant: 電腦暫時無法儲存配對變更，請稍後重試。
The computer could not save pairing chan.ja: コンピューターはペアリングの変更を保存できませんでした。後でもう一度試してください。
The computer could not save pairing chan.ko: 컴퓨터가 페어링 변경 사항을 저장할 수 없습니다. 나중에 다시 시도하세요.
The computer could not save pairing chan.pt: O computador não conseguiu salvar as alterações de emparelhamento. Tente novamente mais tarde.
The computer could not save pairing chan.es: La computadora no pudo guardar los cambios de emparejamiento. Vuelve a intentarlo más tarde.
The computer could not save pairing chan.it: Il computer non è riuscito a salvare le modifiche di abbinamento. Riprova più tardi.
The computer could not save pairing chan.ru: Компьютеру не удалось сохранить изменения сопряжения. Повторите попытку позже.
The computer could not save pairing chan.id: Komputer tidak dapat menyimpan perubahan pemasangan. Coba lagi nanti.
The computer could not save pairing chan.tr: Bilgisayar eşleştirme değişikliklerini kaydedemedi. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.
The computer could not save pairing chan.vi: Máy tính không thể lưu các thay đổi ghép nối. Hãy thử lại sau.
The computer could not save pairing chan.th: คอมพิวเตอร์ไม่สามารถบันทึกการเปลี่ยนแปลงการจับคู่ได้ ลองอีกครั้งในภายหลัง
The computer could not save pairing chan.nl: De computer kan de koppelingswijzigingen niet opslaan. Probeer het later opnieuw.
The computer could not save pairing chan.pl: Komputer nie mógł zapisać zmian w parowaniu. Spróbuj ponownie później.
The computer could not save pairing chan.uk: Комп’ютер не зміг зберегти зміни сполучення. Повторіть спробу пізніше.
The computer could not save pairing chan.hi: कंप्यूटर युग्मन परिवर्तन सहेज नहीं सका. बाद में पुन: प्रयास।
The computer could not save pairing chan.ms: Komputer tidak dapat menyimpan perubahan berpasangan. Cuba lagi nanti.

Too many attempts. Try again later..en: Too many attempts. Try again later.
Too many attempts. Try again later..zh-Hans: 尝试次数过多，请稍后再试。
Too many attempts. Try again later..fr: Trop de tentatives. Réessayez plus tard.
Too many attempts. Try again later..de: Zu viele Versuche. Später erneut versuchen.
Too many attempts. Try again later..zh-Hant: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。
Too many attempts. Try again later..ja: 試行回数が多すぎます。後でもう一度試してください。
Too many attempts. Try again later..ko: 시도 횟수가 너무 많습니다. 나중에 다시 시도하세요.
Too many attempts. Try again later..pt: Muitas tentativas. Tente novamente mais tarde.
Too many attempts. Try again later..es: Demasiados intentos. Vuelve a intentarlo más tarde.
Too many attempts. Try again later..ru: Слишком много попыток. Повторите попытку позже.
Too many attempts. Try again later..id: Terlalu banyak upaya. Coba lagi nanti.
Too many attempts. Try again later..tr: Çok fazla deneme. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.
Too many attempts. Try again later..vi: Quá nhiều nỗ lực. Hãy thử lại sau.
Too many attempts. Try again later..th: มีความพยายามมากเกินไป ลองอีกครั้งในภายหลัง
Too many attempts. Try again later..nl: Te veel pogingen. Probeer het later opnieuw.
Too many attempts. Try again later..pl: Zbyt wiele prób. Spróbuj ponownie później.
Too many attempts. Try again later..hi: बहुत अधिक प्रयास. बाद में पुन: प्रयास।
Too many attempts. Try again later..ms: Terlalu banyak percubaan. Cuba lagi nanti.

Start sharing on the computer, then try.en: Start sharing on the computer, then try again.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.zh-Hans: 电脑尚未开启屏幕共享，请在电脑端开启后重试。
Start sharing on the computer, then try.fr: Activez le partage sur l’ordinateur, puis réessayez.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.de: Freigabe am Computer starten und erneut versuchen.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.ar: ابدأ المشاركة على الحاسوب ثم أعد المحاولة.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.zh-Hant: 電腦尚未開啟螢幕共享，請在電腦端開啟後重試。
Start sharing on the computer, then try.ja: コンピューターで共有を開始してから、もう一度試してください。
Start sharing on the computer, then try.ko: 컴퓨터에서 공유를 시작한 후 다시 시도하세요.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.pt: Comece a compartilhar no computador e tente novamente.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.es: Comience a compartir en la computadora y vuelva a intentarlo.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.it: Inizia la condivisione sul computer, quindi riprova.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.ru: Откройте общий доступ на компьютере и повторите попытку.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.id: Mulai berbagi di komputer, lalu coba lagi.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.tr: Bilgisayarda paylaşmaya başlayın ve tekrar deneyin.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.vi: Bắt đầu chia sẻ trên máy tính, sau đó thử lại.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.th: เริ่มแชร์บนคอมพิวเตอร์ จากนั้นลองอีกครั้ง
Start sharing on the computer, then try.nl: Begin met delen op de computer en probeer het opnieuw.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.pl: Rozpocznij udostępnianie na komputerze i spróbuj ponownie.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.uk: Почніть ділитися на комп’ютері та повторіть спробу.
Start sharing on the computer, then try.hi: कंप्यूटर पर साझा करना प्रारंभ करें, फिर पुनः प्रयास करें।
Start sharing on the computer, then try.ms: Mula berkongsi pada komputer, kemudian cuba lagi.

The computer is in use by another connec.en: The computer is in use by another connection. End that connection and try again.
The computer is in use by another connec.zh-Hans: 电脑正被其他连接使用，请结束原连接后再试。
The computer is in use by another connec.fr: Une autre connexion utilise l’ordinateur. Terminez-la et réessayez.
The computer is in use by another connec.de: Eine andere Verbindung nutzt den Computer. Diese beenden und erneut versuchen.
The computer is in use by another connec.ar: يستخدم اتصال آخر الحاسوب. أنهِ ذلك الاتصال ثم أعد المحاولة.
The computer is in use by another connec.zh-Hant: 電腦正被其他連線使用，請結束原連線後再試。
The computer is in use by another connec.ja: コンピュータは別の接続で使用されています。接続を終了して、もう一度試してください。
The computer is in use by another connec.ko: 컴퓨터가 다른 연결에서 사용 중입니다. 해당 연결을 종료하고 다시 시도하십시오.
The computer is in use by another connec.pt: O computador está sendo usado por outra conexão. Encerre essa conexão e tente novamente.
The computer is in use by another connec.es: La computadora está siendo utilizada por otra conexión. Finalice esa conexión y vuelva a intentarlo.
The computer is in use by another connec.it: Il computer è utilizzato da un'altra connessione. Termina la connessione e riprova.
The computer is in use by another connec.ru: Компьютер используется другим соединением. Завершите это соединение и повторите попытку.
The computer is in use by another connec.id: Komputer sedang digunakan oleh koneksi lain. Akhiri koneksi itu dan coba lagi.
The computer is in use by another connec.tr: Bilgisayar başka bir bağlantı tarafından kullanılıyor. Bu bağlantıyı sonlandırın ve tekrar deneyin.
The computer is in use by another connec.vi: Máy tính đang được sử dụng bởi một kết nối khác. Ngắt kết nối đó và thử lại.
The computer is in use by another connec.th: คอมพิวเตอร์ถูกใช้งานโดยการเชื่อมต่ออื่น สิ้นสุดการเชื่อมต่อนั้นแล้วลองอีกครั้ง
The computer is in use by another connec.nl: De computer wordt gebruikt door een andere verbinding. Beëindig die verbinding en probeer het opnieuw.
The computer is in use by another connec.pl: Komputer jest używany przez inne połączenie. Zakończ to połączenie i spróbuj ponownie.
The computer is in use by another connec.uk: Комп’ютер використовується іншим з’єднанням. Розірвіть це з’єднання та повторіть спробу.
The computer is in use by another connec.hi: कंप्यूटर किसी अन्य कनेक्शन द्वारा उपयोग में है. उस कनेक्शन को समाप्त करें और पुनः प्रयास करें।
The computer is in use by another connec.ms: Komputer sedang digunakan oleh sambungan lain. Tamatkan sambungan itu dan cuba lagi.

A DeskPort client took over the computer.en: A DeskPort client took over the computer. The browser connection has ended.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.zh-Hans: 电脑已被 DeskPort 客户端接管，网页连接已结束。
A DeskPort client took over the computer.fr: Un client DeskPort a repris l’ordinateur. La connexion du navigateur est terminée.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.de: Ein DeskPort-Client hat den Computer übernommen. Die Browserverbindung wurde beendet.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.ar: استلم عميل DeskPort التحكم بالحاسوب. انتهى اتصال المتصفح.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.zh-Hant: 電腦已被 DeskPort 用戶端接管，網頁連線已結束。
A DeskPort client took over the computer.ja: DeskPort クライアントがコンピュータを乗っ取りました。ブラウザ接続が終了しました。
A DeskPort client took over the computer.ko: DeskPort 클라이언트가 컴퓨터를 인수했습니다. 브라우저 연결이 종료되었습니다.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.pt: Um cliente DeskPort assumiu o controle do computador. A conexão do navegador foi encerrada.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.es: Un cliente DeskPort se hizo cargo de la computadora. La conexión del navegador ha finalizado.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.it: Un client DeskPort ha preso il controllo del computer. La connessione al browser è terminata.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.ru: Клиент DeskPort взял на себя управление компьютером. Соединение браузера прервано.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.id: Klien DeskPort mengambil alih komputer. Koneksi browser telah berakhir.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.tr: Bir DeskPort istemcisi bilgisayarı devraldı. Tarayıcı bağlantısı sona erdi.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.vi: Một ứng dụng khách DeskPort đã tiếp quản máy tính. Kết nối trình duyệt đã kết thúc.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.th: ไคลเอ็นต์ DeskPort เข้าควบคุมคอมพิวเตอร์ การเชื่อมต่อเบราว์เซอร์สิ้นสุดลงแล้ว
A DeskPort client took over the computer.nl: Een DeskPort-client heeft de computer overgenomen. De browserverbinding is beëindigd.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.pl: Klient DeskPort przejął komputer. Połączenie przeglądarki zostało zakończone.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.uk: Клієнт DeskPort заволодів комп’ютером. Підключення браузера закінчилося.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.hi: एक डेस्कपोर्ट क्लाइंट ने कंप्यूटर पर कब्ज़ा कर लिया। ब्राउज़र कनेक्शन समाप्त हो गया है.
A DeskPort client took over the computer.ms: Pelanggan DeskPort mengambil alih komputer. Sambungan penyemak imbas telah ditamatkan.

Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.en: Browser streaming is unavailable. Check the computer.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.zh-Hans: 这台电脑暂时无法提供浏览器串流，请检查电脑端状态。
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.fr: Diffusion par navigateur indisponible. Vérifiez l’ordinateur.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.ar: البث عبر المتصفح غير متاح. تحقق من الحاسوب.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.zh-Hant: 這台電腦暫時無法提供瀏覽器串流，請檢查電腦端狀態。
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.ja: ブラウザストリーミングは利用できません。コンピューターを確認してください。
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.ko: 브라우저 스트리밍을 사용할 수 없습니다. 컴퓨터를 확인하세요.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.pt: O streaming do navegador não está disponível. Verifique o computador.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.es: La transmisión por navegador no está disponible. Revisa la computadora.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.it: Lo streaming del browser non è disponibile. Controlla il computer.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.ru: Потоковая передача через браузер недоступна. Проверьте компьютер.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.id: Streaming peramban tidak tersedia. Periksa komputer.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.tr: Tarayıcı akışı kullanılamıyor. Bilgisayarı kontrol edin.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.vi: Tính năng phát trực tuyến qua trình duyệt không khả dụng. Kiểm tra máy tính.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.th: การสตรีมเบราว์เซอร์ไม่พร้อมใช้งาน ตรวจสอบคอมพิวเตอร์
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.nl: Browserstreaming is niet beschikbaar. Controleer de computer.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.pl: Przesyłanie strumieniowe przeglądarki jest niedostępne. Sprawdź komputer.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.uk: Потокова передача в браузері недоступна. Перевірте комп'ютер.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.hi: ब्राउज़र स्ट्रीमिंग अनुपलब्ध है. कंप्यूटर की जाँच करें.
Browser streaming is unavailable. Check.ms: Penstriman penyemak imbas tidak tersedia. Semak komputer.

This browser does not support H.264 Base.en: This browser does not support H.264 Baseline 3.1. Update it or use another browser.
This browser does not support H.264 Base.zh-Hans: 当前浏览器不支持所需的视频格式（H.264 Baseline 3.1），请更新或更换浏览器。
This browser does not support H.264 Base.fr: Ce navigateur ne prend pas en charge H.264 Baseline 3.1. Mettez-le à jour ou changez de navigateur.
This browser does not support H.264 Base.de: Dieser Browser unterstützt H.264 Baseline 3.1 nicht. Aktualisieren oder anderen Browser verwenden.
This browser does not support H.264 Base.ar: هذا المتصفح لا يدعم H.264 Baseline 3.1. حدّثه أو استخدم متصفحًا آخر.
This browser does not support H.264 Base.zh-Hant: 目前瀏覽器不支援 H.264 Baseline 3.1，請更新或更換瀏覽器。
